items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ne istifa diya
items.detail: 33 saal se Nvidia chala rahe Huang ne turant prabhav se istifa de diya; CFO Colette Kress antarim CEO bani aur board sthayi CEO ki talaash karega — company ne istife ka kaaran nahi bataya.
items.exam_angle: AI chip udyog aur corporate netritva — arthvyavastha aur takneek ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America ne Japan se sainik kharch teen guna manga
items.detail: Trump prashasan ne 2027 se paanch saal ke liye sainikon ki mejbani par 3 trillion yen (lagbhag $19 arab) ki maang ki; Japan lagbhag aadha, 1.5 trillion yen, dene par vichaar kar raha hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Japan suraksha gathbandhan aur raksha kharch — antarrashtriya sambandhon ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pakistan: chhaapon me 74 aatankvadi mare gaye
items.detail: Pakistan sena ne Balochistan aur Khyber Pakhtunkhwa me 3 November se chale abhiyaanon me 74 aatankvadiyon ko maarne ka daava kiya; hathiyaar aur visfotak bhi baramad hue.
items.exam_angle: Pakistan me aatankvaad-virodhi abhiyaan — padosi deshon ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Washington gym goli: 1 ki maut, 4 ghayal
items.detail: Logan Circle ke Vida Fitness gym me 55 saal ke doctor Matt Lambert ne building manager James Stuart ko goli maar di, phir apne flat se 4 logon ko ghayal kiya aur khud ko goli maar li; vivaad building ki marammat ko lekar tha.
items.exam_angle: America me banduk hinsa aur kanoon-vyavastha — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Volgograd par 1,198 drone, 4 ki maut
items.detail: Russia ke mutabik raat bhar Ukraine ne lagbhag 1,198 drone bheje — Volgograd ke audyogik kshetra me hamle me 4 karmchari mare aur 2 ghayal hue; 15 se zyada kshetron me drone roke gaye.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur drone hamle — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31: Jalvayu vitt par UN pramukh ka zor
items.detail: Antalya me chal rahe COP31 me UN jalvayu pramukh Simon Stiell ne kaha desh apne vittiya vaade poore karein aur 2035 tak adaptation finance teen guna karne ki koshish tez ho.
items.exam_angle: COP31 aur jalvayu vitt — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sammelan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ki chetavni: America ki madad dushmani
items.detail: Iran ke videsh mantralaya ne kaha America ke khilaf karwai me sainya ya rasad madad dene wale deshon ko dushman mana jayega — nausena, sainya upkaran ya karmiyon ki madad bhi isme shamil.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz aur West Asia tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan PM Takaichi pehli baar China jayengi
items.detail: Japan ki PM Sanae Takaichi 16–19 November ko Philippines aur China jayengi — Shenzhen me APEC shikhar sammelan me hissa lengi; PM banne ke baad unki pehli China yatra hai, Taiwan par unke bayan ke baad se dono deshon ke rishte tanav me hain.
items.exam_angle: Japan-China sambandh aur APEC — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ka daava: Bahrain me US radar nishana
items.detail: Iran ke Revolutionary Guards ne daava kiya ki unhone Bahrain me America ke early-warning radar ko nishana banaya — Sirik me telecom tower par hawai hamle ka badla bataya; America ya Bahrain ki taraf se abhi koi pushti nahi aayi.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz aur West Asia me America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UN ne Houthi pratibandh 2027 tak badhaye
items.detail: UN Suraksha Parishad ne sarvasammati se Yemen par pratibandh badhaye — Houthi netaon par sampatti-jabti aur yatra-pratibandh 14 November 2027 tak, aur drone-missile banane wale dohre-upyog wale saman par rok kadi ki.
items.exam_angle: Yemen sankat aur UN pratibandh — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump ne Vance ko Iran vaarta se hataya
items.detail: Trump ne kaha America ko Iran se koi samjhauta nahi chahiye aur up-rashtrapati JD Vance ko Iran vaarta se hatakar gharelu dhokhadhadi ke khilaf abhiyan par lagaya; Vance ne yuddh ki rajnaitik keemat par sawal uthaye the.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur Hormuz — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Finland: Baltic me Russian jahaaz par hamla
items.detail: Finland ki sena ne Gulf of Finland me ek Russian yuddhpot par hamle ka pata lagaya; Ukraine ki Security Service ne hamle ki zimmedari li — Finland ne kaha use koi turant khatra nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Baltic me NATO-Russia tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Microsoft 365 thap: Outlook-Teams ghanton band
items.detail: Guruvaar ko Microsoft 365 me badi kharabi se Outlook, Teams aur Copilot ghanton band rahe — 74 deshon me asar, Downdetector par 1.38 lakh shikayatein; Microsoft ne kaha server bahaal ho rahe hain, karan ki jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Gaza: Nasser Hospital par hamla, 6 ki maut
items.detail: Khan Younis ke Nasser Hospital ki surgery ward par guruvaar subah Israeli hamle me ek surgeon aur 13 saal ke ladke samet 6 ki maut, 27 ghayal; IDF ne kaha Hamas commander nishana tha, WHO ne nuksan ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Yuddh-viram ke bawjood Gaza par hamla — West Asia aur antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ireland me Zelenskyy se mile Witkoff-Kushner
items.detail: Moscow ke baad America ke doot Witkoff aur Kushner ne Dublin me Zelenskyy se milkar yuddh ke sabse bade kaidi adla-badli ki taiyaari ki pushti ki; agle daur ki baatchit me Europe bhi shamil hoga.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine shanti vartaa aur Europe ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandhon ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Brooklyn imarat dhahi: 8 ki maut
items.detail: New York ke Brooklyn me budhvaar shaam teen-manzila imarat paas ke nirman sthal par gir gayi — 8 ki maut, jinme 2 bachche aur 2 mazdoor shamil, 18 ghayal; shahar ke vibhag ne kaha paas ki khudai me 'asurakshit nirman kaam' kaaran bana; mayor ne 100 se zyada nirman sthalon ki jaanch ke aadesh diye.

items.headline: Riyadh par Houthi drone, gathbandhan ne roke
items.detail: Guruvaar ko Saudi gathbandhan ne Riyadh kshetra me do aur Eastern Province me ek Houthi drone ko rok kar gira diya; Houthi ne tel aur sainya thikanon par hamle ka daava kiya; UNSC ne Yemen pratibandh ek saal badhaye.
items.exam_angle: Lal Sagar aur Hormuz ke paas tel supply — Bharat ki urja suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Moscow par raat bhar drone hamla, udanein thap
items.detail: Moscow ke mayor ke mutabik raat 9:34 se subah 2:08 ke beech 100 se zyada drone roke gaye; Sheremetyevo, Domodedovo aur Zhukovsky hawai addon par udanein roki gayin; nuksan ya hatahat ki koi pushti nahi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh me drone yuddh aur nagrik havaai suraksha — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye ahem.

items.headline: Kansas governor chunaav: Democrat Holscher jeeti
items.detail: Democrat Cindy Holscher ne Kansas ke governor chunaav me Republican Ty Masterson ko haraya; AP ne guruvaar ko jeet ki ghoshna ki — Holscher ne naye data centre par asthayi rok ka wada kiya tha.
items.exam_angle: America ke midterm chunav aur rajyon me satta santulan — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Dark web par vaishvik chhapa: 354 giraftaar
items.detail: Operation TorNado me 14 deshon ki police ne dark web par nasha bechne walon par chhapa mara — 354 giraftaariyan, 5.7 tonne nasha aur $234 million ki sampatti jabt; sabse zyada giraftaariyan America (132) aur Britain (59) me hui.
items.exam_angle: Dark web, fentanyl aur cyber-apradh ke khilaf vaishvik karwai — antarrashtriya suraksha aur cyber-apradh ke liye ahem.

items.headline: Italy: doosre din bhi farzi bomb dhamki
items.detail: Italy me guruvaar ko bhi 3,778 schoolon ko email se farzi bomb dhamki mili — budhwar ko 6,300 school prabhavit hue the; sirf 77 school khaali karaye gaye, kahin visfotak nahi mila; sarkar ne naya protocol jaari kiya.
items.exam_angle: Europe me hybrid warfare aur cyber-suraksha — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Putin: Europe bhi Ukraine vaarta me shamil
items.detail: America ke doot Steve Witkoff ke mutabik, Putin ne agle daur ki Ukraine shaanti vaarta me Europe ke pratinidhiyon ko shamil karne par sahamati di — lekin Kremlin ke sahayak Ushakov ne iski pushti nahi ki; Abu Dhabi vaarta me bade kaidi adla-badli par bhi sahamati bani.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shaanti vaarta me Europe ki bhoomika aur vaishvik shakti santulan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Gaza ke liye 53 deshon ki madad-appeal
items.detail: 53 UN sadasya deshon aur sangathanon ne Israel ki aane wali sarkar se Gaza me bina rok-tok madad ki maang ki — UN relief chief Tom Fletcher ne kaha 1.5 lakh se zyada tent aur sardi ka saman bahar ruka hai, sabhi crossing khulni chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Gaza manaviya sankat aur UN — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Saudi: EU Houthi ko aatanki ghoshit kare
items.detail: Saudi Arabia EU par dabaav daal raha hai ki Yemen ke Iran-samarthit Houthi sangathan ko aatanki sangathan ghoshit kare — Houthi ke Saudi par lagbhag roz ke hamle jaari hain; chhah European adhikariyon ke mutabik zyadaatar sadasya desh hichkicha rahe hain, kyunki isse Yemen shanti vaarta ke raaste band ho sakte hain; faisle ke liye 27 sadasya deshon ki sarvasammati chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Yemen sangharsh, EU ki videsh neeti aur aatankwad-suchi — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
